Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //wv•m.dilg.com. h DILG OPINION No. 19 s. 3023 HAR 22 2023 DIR. ARACELI A. SAN JOSE Officer-in-Charge, DILG-CordiIIera Administrative Region Barangay Center, Upper Session Rd. Cor. North Drive, Baguio City Dear Dir. San Jose: This pertains to your letter dated 3 January 2022, requesting the Department's guidance and opinion on whether an ordinance or resolution is necessary to be enacted before a position can be created/included in Executive Budget. You are inquiring on which should prevail between the opinion of the Civil Service Commission (CSC) which requires the need for creation of positions before funding and appointment, with that of the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) which opines that funding positions may suffice. At the outset, the DBM is in the best position to answer your query as it is tasked, pursuant to Section 115 of the Local Government Code to furnish the local development councils information on financial resources and budgetary allocations applicable to their respective jurisdictions to guide them in their planning functions. Be that as it may, the Documentary requirements for budgetary requests on the creation of new class title/position for local government units are the following: Letter-Request of the Local Chief Executive Justification for the Creation of the Class Title/Position Duly Accomplished Position Form (PDF) for each Position Organizational Chart Position Allocation List by Department/division/unit Functions of each Department/division/unit, with emphasis on the unit where the position to be created will be deployed Sanggunian Resolution Creating the New Position/s Appropriation Ordinance providing funds for the creation of new position/s Certification from the Local Budget Officer/Local Finance Committee that the PS cap/limitation has not been exceeded despite the creationl This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to the opinion of more competent authorityhes. 1 dbm.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/OPCCB/brochures/doc_organization.htm "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Based on the foregoing, sanggunian resolution creating the new position and appropriation ordinance providing funds for the creation of new position are both of importance. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, ORITY OF THE SECRETARY: BY VICT R.
